newsitem.title: USA: Unocal says abandons offshore Brunei well.
newsitem.headline: Unocal says abandons offshore Brunei well.

text.p: Unocal Corp plugged and abandoned its Perdana Deep-1 well offshore Brunei last week after testing showed no signs of oil or natural gas, the company announced Tuesday.
The California-based oil giant will record an after-tax charge of $12 million, or 5 cents per share, to operating earnings for the second quarter related to the unsuccessful well.

The company's Unocal Borneo Utara, Ltd., subsidiary acquired a 26.95 percent interest in the exploration project under a farm-in agreement with the operator, Fletcher Challenge Energy Borneo, Ltd., subject to government approval. Under that agreement, Unocal Borneo is to pay 100 percent of the costs of the Perdana Deep-1 well.
